labels.text: `@modelcontextprotocol/core` (`packages/core/src/index.ts`) — Public Zod-schema package and the canonical home of the schema source modules (`src/schemas.ts`, `src/auth.ts`, `src/constants.ts`). The root entry re-exports only the `*Schema` Zod constants (MCP spec + OAuth/OpenID) — the published home for raw runtime validation (`CallToolResultSchema.parse(...)`); runtime-neutral (`zod` is its only dependency). The `./internal` subpath re-exports the schema modules wholesale for the sibling packages: `core-internal` re-exports them at the old module paths, and the `client`/`server`/`server-legacy` bundles resolve `@modelcontextprotocol/core/internal` as a real external dependency instead of carrying their own schema copies (their public surfaces stay Zod-free).
